clue.text: Rousing a boy in one part of house

parts.note: one can be written as the article a, giving A

indicators.note: in tells us the article and the boy's name sit inside the part of the house

parts.note: a wing is one section of a large house
Ken is a boy's name

explanation.surface: Someone wakes up a lad in one wing of the family home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A and KEN inside WING (W-AKEN-ING), and that follows A from 'one'.
explanation.definitionFit: Rousing someone is waking them, and an awakening is that act of rousing.

clue.text: Fear produced by bang, is it, when all are losing their heads?

indicators.text: when all are losing their heads
indicators.note: each of the three words bang, is and it loses its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a loud bang is what caused a fright when everyone panics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when all are losing their heads' strips B, I and I from bang, is, it, leaving ANG, S, T.
explanation.definitionFit: Angst is a feeling of dread or anxiety, a form of fear.

clue.text: Appendage on head of insect upset girl

parts.note: an ant is an insect

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the girl's name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A bug sitting on a girl's head gives her a fright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns ANNE into ENNA, placed after ANT; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An antenna is a feeler, a sensory appendage growing from an insect's head.

clue.text: English-style college

parts.note: ton means fashion or style, as in the phrase 'the ton'

explanation.surface: A school built in the English manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton is a famous English public school, formally Eton College.

clue.text: Exotic box in Moulin Rouge

indicators.note: in signals that the answer is sitting within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A strange casket turns up at the Paris cabaret.
explanation.walkthrough: INRO runs across MoulIN ROuge; an inro is a small Japanese box worn at the sash.
explanation.definitionFit: An inro is a little Japanese case for medicines, so from a Western view a foreign box.

clue.text: Person staying with one partner, showing reasonable judgment

parts.note: a guest is someone staying in your home
the numeral one looks like the letter I
a mate is a partner

explanation.surface: A houseguest with a companion appears sensible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'showing' are links; the answer is a variant spelling of 'guesstimate'.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough but sensible estimate is a reasonable judgment arrived at without full data.

clue.text: Money for one whose verse was free

definitions.meaning: Ezra ..., the American poet, wrote much free verse

explanation.definitionFit: The British unit of currency shares its name with the modernist poet Ezra Pound.

clue.text: Work steadily without reserve, possibly in a pig-headed way

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: to ply is to work steadily at something

indicators.note: possibly suggests the word reserve could be rearranged

explanation.surface: Grinding on without holding anything back might seem stubborn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns RESERVE into ERVERSE, which 'without' puts inside PLY: P-ERVERSE-LY.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting perversely means contrarily and stubbornly, which is pig-headed behaviour.

clue.text: Awfully mundane, lacking title

indicators.note: awfully suggests the following word is mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Something terribly dull goes without a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Unnamed means without a name, i.e. lacking a title.

clue.text: Warship in navy finally restored at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are jumbled
finally points to the closing letter of navy

explanation.surface: A navy ship is restored and back on the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' gives Y from navy; 'at sea' rearranges Y plus RESTORED.
explanation.definitionFit: A destroyer is a fast naval warship.

clue.text: Find where you stand in relation to major points appropriately placed here

definitions.text: Find where you stand in relation to major points appropriately placed here

parts.words: Find where you stand in relation to major points appropriately placed here
parts.note: the phrase means orient yourself by the compass points, which the puzzle places at the edges of the grid

explanation.surface: An instruction to orient yourself by the compass directions marked in this grid.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's compass rose ties in: the four direction words are set in the grid at the matching compass positions.
explanation.definitionFit: To orient oneself is to work out one's position relative to north, south, east and west.

clue.text: Wine that's held up by guys getting tight

definitions.text: that's held up by guys getting tight
definitions.meaning: guys are the ropes of a camping shelter, which stands when they are pulled taut

explanation.definitionFit: Tent is both a sweet red wine and a canvas shelter held up by guy ropes.

clue.text: Flag showing king's on board vessel

indicators.note: on board means aboard, i.e. inside the ship

parts.note: a steamer is a steamship
R is the abbreviation for rex, king

explanation.surface: A banner announces that the monarch is aboard the ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' puts R into STEAMER after the T.
explanation.definitionFit: A streamer is a long narrow flag or pennant.

clue.text: Prosperous, healthy and free of disease, we hear

indicators.note: we hear marks a sound-alike

parts.note: well (healthy) plus healed (cured) sounds like the answer

explanation.surface: Rich, fit and cured, or so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-heeled is an idiom for wealthy, having good shoes.

clue.text: Order in Italian city mostly one kind of pasta

indicators.note: in shows the order word goes inside the shortened city
mostly removes the final letter

parts.note: Torino is the Italian name for Turin
to tell someone to do something is to order them
the numeral one looks like I

explanation.surface: Someone orders a type of pasta in Turin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims TORINO to TORIN; 'in' puts TELL inside it (TOR-TELL-IN), then I is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Tortellini are small stuffed ring-shaped pasta, one variety among many.

clue.text: Private compartment on board, say, with berth turned round

parts.note: to say is to state

indicators.note: turned round tells us to reverse the word for berth

parts.note: to berth a boat is to moor it

explanation.surface: Booking a private cabin aboard, with the bunk set the other way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned round' turns MOOR into ROOM. 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A stateroom is a private cabin on a ship.

clue.text: Fighting a judge is, in a way, opposing imperialism

indicators.note: in places the run of pieces inside the road abbreviation

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
fighting is war

explanation.surface: Battling a magistrate is, in a sense, resisting imperial rule.
explanation.walkthrough: WAR+A+J+IS goes inside ST. A swarajist supported swaraj, Indian self-rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Swarajists campaigned for Indian independence from British rule, so they opposed imperialism.

clue.text: Lady's out to lunch in blue fashion

indicators.note: out to lunch means crazy, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: the letters of the word with its S

explanation.surface: A woman away at a midday meal leaves her friends feeling low.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lady's' is read as 'Lady is', its S counting as fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue means sad, so doing something in a blue way is doing it unhappily.

clue.text: Pronouncement of a pope comes as shock

indicators.note: a pronouncement is something spoken, so the sound counts

parts.note: of a pope can be expressed as 'a papal'

explanation.surface: A papal statement causes consternation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a papal' said quickly sounds like the answer; 'comes as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal is to shock or horrify.

clue.text: Secular, but supporting old temple

parts.note: pro means in favour of
fane is an archaic word for temple

explanation.surface: Non-religious, yet backing an ancient shrine.
explanation.definitionFit: Profane means not sacred, i.e. secular.

clue.text: Is a lottery mostly fixed as a form of gambling?

indicators.note: a fixed contest is rigged, so the letters are arranged anew
mostly drops the final letter

explanation.surface: Asking whether a lottery is largely rigged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts LOTTERY to LOTTER; 'fixed' rearranges IS A LOTTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A totaliser is a betting system pooling stakes, a form of gambling.

clue.text: Foreign lady so addressed in gross ignorance

indicators.note: in shows the answer is buried among the letters of the next words

explanation.surface: A woman abroad is spoken to with crass ignorance.
explanation.definitionFit: Signora is the Italian form of address for a married woman.

clue.text: A lovable eccentric, paramountly

indicators.note: eccentric means odd, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A charming oddball, above all else.
explanation.definitionFit: Above all means most importantly, i.e. paramountly.

clue.text: Hang tough, ignoring the odds in eager excitement

indicators.note: we skip the odd-numbered letters and keep the even ones

explanation.surface: Stay firm, disregarding the betting, in great anticipation.
explanation.walkthrough: Even letters of HANG TOUGH: A, G, O, G.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog means eagerly excited.

clue.text: Causes of laughter or tears, for example

definitions.text: Causes of laughter or tears, for example

parts.words: Causes of laughter or tears, for example
parts.note: laughing gas and tear gas provoke laughing and crying

explanation.definitionFit: Laughing gas and tear gas are examples of vapours that induce laughter and tears.

clue.text: Provider of special fare from Asian city, say

indicators.note: say signals a sound-alike

parts.note: Delhi is a city in India

explanation.surface: A shop selling special food from an Indian city.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicatessen supplies fine or specialist foods.

clue.text: Party animal

definitions.meaning: a ... party is a groom's night out

explanation.definitionFit: Stag is a pre-wedding night out and also a male deer.

clue.text: Wherever you look, inertia's gripping learners — awful!

indicators.note: gripping means holding within

parts.note: inertia is inaction, with the S of the possessive
L is the learner sign, so learners give LL
dire means awful

explanation.surface: Everywhere you turn, sloth is taking hold of students; dreadful!
explanation.walkthrough: 'gripping' puts LL and DIRE inside INACTIONS: IN-A-LLDIRE-CTIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: In every direction means everywhere, wherever one looks.

clue.text: Material that's used for border, partly

definitions.meaning: the River ... forms part of the border between England and Scotland

explanation.definitionFit: Tweed is a rough woollen cloth and a river marking part of the Anglo-Scottish border.

clue.text: Gelatin from sturgeon partly fills schooner, say

parts.note: something that partly fills a container is in it
a schooner is a type of drinking glass

explanation.surface: A gelatin from fish half-fills a glass of sherry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'schooner' suggests a ship but is a tall drinking glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Isinglass is a pure gelatin made from fish swim bladders, especially sturgeon.
